api.headersHelper:
sh -c 'PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"; command -v provalab-auth >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf "provalab-auth CLI not found on PATH (~/.local/bin missing?)
" >&2; exit 1; }; token=$(provalab-auth token 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$token" ] || { printf "provalab-auth token empty — run: provalab-auth login
" >&2; exit 1; }; printf "Authorization: Bearer %s
" "$token"'
